title: manifest-chaining-and-signed-provenance-for-quant-artifacts
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Quantization artifacts (FP8/INT8 profiles, calibration caches, and validation reports) are changing frequently during model onboarding. We lack a deterministic, cryptographically-verifiable way to: 1) reproduce a quantization run, 2) prove the origin and inputs used for a profile, and 3) safely roll back to a known-good artifact while preserving provenance and regulatory audit trails.

Goal: Implement a manifest-chaining scheme + signed provenance metadata for quant artifacts stored in the artifacts registry so that every artifact is: (a) deterministically reproducible from inputs, (b) traceable to calibration datasets, code, and hyperparameters, and (c) rollback-friendly with a UI + API flow for safe re-deploy. This ticket covers design and an initial implementation of the manifest format, signing workflow, and CI validation checks.

Scope:
- Define a JSON manifest schema for quant artifacts (model-commit, quant-profile, calibration-seed, dataset-snapshot-ref, toolchain-version, kernel-config, quant-hyperparams, deterministic-rng-seed, metrics-summary).
- Include content-addressable checksums (sha256) for blobs and the manifest itself.
- Support manifest chaining: manifests can reference previous-manifests by manifest-hash to build an immutable provenance chain.
- Implement GPG/PKI signing for manifests and store signer-id in metadata for audit.
- Integrate deterministic-calibration flags and seeds into the manifest to guarantee reproducible calibration runs.
- Extend artifact registry API to return signed manifest + verification endpoint.
- CI: add reproducibility check that re-runs calibration on a trimmed golden subset and validates metric deltas within tolerances.
- Console: add reference view for manifest chain and a gated rollback action that verifies signature + compatibility matrix before allowing a rollback.
- Backwards compatibility: provide migration path for existing quant artifacts into new manifest format (importer tool).

Out of scope: full HSM-backed signing integration (follow-up), enterprise policy UI for signature enforcement (separate PM ticket).
comments: 2025-01-29 — Maya Chen: Initial spec draft uploaded to Confluence. Key open question: do we include the compiled kernel binary checksum in the manifest or only kernel config metainfo?

2025-01-30 — Alejandro Ruiz: Kernel binary checksum included in latest draft. Decision: store kernel ABI version + sha256 of the compiled kernel when available; fall back to config-only for proprietary kernel builds. Added field kernel_binary_sha256.

2025-02-03 — ML Infra review (R. Dutta): Requested deterministic RNG seed and a strict treatment of non-deterministic ops. Added calibration_rng_seed and calibration_env_hash fields. Also recommended storing the git commit hash of the quant toolchain.

2025-02-10 — Security (L. Patel): Requested signed manifests and key rotation plan. We will prototype with GPG keys in CI and follow up with HSM integration in a later ticket. Security review flagged as required.

2025-02-18 — PM (Sofia Martinez): Asked for Console UX: show a compact provenance chain + ‘verify’ button. Also asked for a conservative rollback UX that runs a dry-run validation in staging before permitting production switch.

2025-02-24 — Alejandro Ruiz: Implemented manifest schema v1 in artifact-registry. Open PR: artifact-registry#117. Basic manifest creation and sha256 signing implemented; verification endpoint added. Unit tests added for manifest parsing.

2025-02-25 — CI: reproducibility check run failed on model X with metric drift 0.85% above tolerance. Investigation: non-deterministic collect_stats op in calibration harness when multi-threading enabled. Workaround: pin thread_count=1 in harness until we implement op-level determinism.

2025-03-01 — Design (Nina Park): Reviewed Console mockups. Request: show raw manifest, human-readable diff between manifests, and a small warnings panel if calibration tolerance exceeded. UX iteration planned for next cycle.

2025-03-03 — Alejandro Ruiz: Merged manifest ingestion pipeline for new uploads. Migration importer prototype available at artifact-registry#import-proto. Next: add signed manifest display in Console and implement gated rollback API.
